systems.system: Digital payment arrangement at civil registration centres (unnamed)
systems.country_label: dispositif de paiement numérique / paiements digitaux
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Administration territoriale et de la Décentralisation, with the Direction nationale de l'état civil; run in the collectivités territoriales
systems.tiers: civil registration centres of the collectivités territoriales; the meeting of 2026-07-30 was with the communes of Bamako District and the urban commune of Kati

note: Digital payment of fees at the communes' civil registration centres, said to have raised nearly FCFA 200 million between July 2024 and May 2026: an application; the document does not say how the centres are connected, and asks only for a report on equipment needs.
